evidence: With jax==0.8.2 installed, importing numpyro from the local codebase fails under DeprecationWarning-as-error at codebase/numpyro/ops/provenance.py line 1: from jax.interpreters.pxla import xla_pmap_p. JAX raises DeprecationWarning: jax.interpreters.pxla.xla_pmap_p is deprecated as of JAX v0.8.2.
steps: Create a fresh virtual environment in this folder.
Install jax==0.8.2 and jaxlib==0.8.2 into the virtual environment.
Run repro.py with PYTHONWARNINGS=error::DeprecationWarning and the local codebase on PYTHONPATH.
Observe the traceback from jax.interpreters.pxla.xla_pmap_p during import of numpyro.
